title: Penny's Soft Parade
markdown:
In a sunny valley lived a little panda cub named Penny. Penny was round and fluffy. She loved soft things. They were her favorite.

Every day Penny found soft grass to nap on. She found fluffy moss to roll in. She wiggled her little toes. Ah, she’d whisper, nuzzling into the green, this is just right. So soft.

Until one day a little thought popped into Penny’s head. I want to find the very softest thing in the whole wide world, she whispered. It will be for a parade. A tiny fluffy parade, just for me and Rill.

Rill the river sprite was Penny’s best friend. Rill sparkled like a water bubble in the sun. Kind and ready for fun. Rill lived in a brook that giggled its way through the valley.

A parade? Rill twinkled, appearing with a little splash. Voice like tiny bells. What a fun idea, Penny.

Something super soft, Penny bounced on her fluffy feet. The softest thing ever.

So off Penny and Rill went. They looked under the biggest dandelions. Soft, like little pillows. Soft, said Penny, snuggling one, but not the softest for my parade. They felt the petals of meadow flowers. Pretty, said Rill, but still not the softest. They even patted a big woolly sheep. The sheep’s wool tickled Penny’s nose a little. Not quite, she said with a sigh.

They looked and looked. Everything was nice and soft. Nothing felt like the super-soft cloud-like softness Penny dreamed of for her parade. A puzzle.

Rill tapped a shimmering finger. Hmm. I know a place. The Whispering Falls.

The Whispering Falls? Penny’s ears perked up.

Yes, said Rill. Sometimes, when the sky is gentle, the softest fluffiest clouds drift down there, so close you can almost touch them. They float down like wishes.

Penny’s eyes sparkled. Let’s go. Let’s go right now.

They padded along the river path. A gentle shushing sound, like soft whispers. Then they saw it. The Whispering Falls. Water tumbled down mossy rocks, singing a soft song. Floating just above the mist were little white wisps. They looked like fallen dreams, soft and perfect.

Look, Penny said, full of delight. Giant puffs of cotton, floating in the air.

Rill giggled. Very soft, Penny. Let’s see if they are soft enough for your parade.

Rill floated up gently. Penny carefully reached out a little paw. Oh, it was soft. So, so soft. Like holding a baby bird’s feather. It smelled like warm sunshine after rain. It made a quiet whispery sound when Penny nudged it. The softest thing they had ever felt.

It’s perfect, Penny squeaked. She did a little happy roll on the mossy ground.

A whole big cloud would be too big for their parade. So Rill and Penny gathered just a few of the softest most delicate wisps. They piled them carefully onto a big smooth leaf.

The cloud fluff was so light. Penny nudged it gently with her nose. Like holding the softest snow, but warm, she whispered. It smelled like fresh air and happy dreams.

That’s the curious thing about cloud fluff, Rill said softly. It holds all the good things from the sky.

With their soft cargo on the leaf, they carried it back to their sunny spot. They made a tiny fluffy path, like a little white carpet. Penny walked along it, and Rill danced beside her. It was the most wonderful softest parade ever, just as Penny had imagined.

After that, Penny and Rill loved going to the Whispering Falls. They would bring back a tiny bit of cloud fluff for their naps. The parade did not need a speech. It needed a path, a friend, and something as soft as a wish that had learned to float.
